criteria.requirement: Implement dpath.walking.walk_paths(root,*,include_containers=False,cycles="error",max_depth=None,max_nodes=None), yielding (tuple_path,original_value) in mapping/list source preorder. Root depth zero and node budget includes root/containers. Empty containers are leaves; optional nonempty containers are emitted too. Track active ancestors iteratively: PathCycleError.path identifies cycles or skip drops only cyclic edges, while shared acyclic objects appear under both paths. Reject invalid budgets, bound before yielding offending nodes, avoid Python recursion and preserve original path key types/input.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
